text: The Patriots got the activation news they were hoping for on Saturday when A.J. Brown was cleared from injured reserve after missing four games with a right high ankle sprain, though the star wide receiver's actual availability for Sunday's Jets matchup remains genuinely uncertain—Brown himself acknowledged his status is "still up in the air" even after practicing this week, leaving head coach Mike Vrabel's final decision pending. The team also elevated safety Elliott Davison from the practice squad and received word that cornerback Christian Gonzalez is expected to play, setting up what the Jets clearly view as consequential divisional business, with Garrett Wilson calling it a "big-ass game" for New York's playoff positioning. On a lighter note, tight end Hunter Henry earned the NFLPA's Community MVP award for Week 6 after hosting his second annual "Freedom to Play" ping pong tournament, continuing a streak of Patriots recognition that includes Mack Hollins' selection just two weeks prior. The Patriots will bring momentum from their 28-point win last week into this encounter, though all eyes remain on whether Brown can actually suit up against a Jets team led by Geno Smith, who has quietly strung together an impressive no-interception streak heading into Sunday.
